nodes.label: APPLY_STANDARD_SETTINGS()
nodes.rationale: Shared C++17, /W4 /WX, no-exceptions settings; plugins use it by default so new options should go on specific targets.

nodes.label: Windows install bundle (data, flutter_assets, DLLs, AOT)
nodes.norm_label: windows install bundle (data, flutter_assets, dlls, aot)
nodes.rationale: Support files are copied next to the executable so it runs in place from Visual Studio; flutter_assets is fully re-copied each build to avoid stale files; AOT library only for Profile/Release.

nodes.label: flutter_assemble target (tool_backend.bat)
nodes.rationale: A phony symbolic output forces the Flutter tool backend to run every build, since the tool exposes no full input/output list.

nodes.label: Runner executable target (main.cpp, flutter_window.cpp, win32_window.cpp)
nodes.rationale: Target name must come from BINARY_NAME in the top-level CMakeLists or flutter run stops working.

nodes.label: Export requires profile and bank details
nodes.norm_label: export requires profile and bank details

nodes.label: Format carry-forward from opening
nodes.rationale: The format carries forward operations from the opening date without duplicating earlier ones.

nodes.label: Balance chart including initial balances
nodes.rationale: Dashboard shows initial balances even before any movement exists.

nodes.label: mi_caja.db (local SQLite database)
nodes.rationale: User data lives in the Documents folder used by the app, not in the code ZIP; it must be copied manually before replacing the project.

nodes.label: Cloud sync not configured (data stays local)
nodes.norm_label: cloud sync not configured (data stays local)
nodes.rationale: Sync messages distinguish success, missing configuration and error; data remains on the device.

nodes.label: Business profile single-row save
nodes.rationale: Key conflict fixed: updating the profile after first save now replaces the single business row.

nodes.label: Correction tests (test/correcciones_test.dart)
nodes.rationale: Nine Flutter tests added; syntax was validated but flutter analyze/test/build were not run because Flutter was not installed in the editing environment.

nodes.label: Windows release build (flutter build windows --release)
nodes.rationale: The whole Release output folder must stay next to the executable because it needs its DLLs and the data folder.

nodes.label: Jakarta font family (bundled)
nodes.rationale: Bundled instead of downloaded on launch because the app works offline (section 2.3); without it the system font would differ between Windows and Android.

nodes.label: PCGE 2023 chart of accounts (assets/pcge.json)
nodes.rationale: Plan Contable General Empresarial 2023 extracted from the course Excel; bundled because Formato 1.1 requires account code and name and the app works offline.

nodes.label: SIL Open Font License 1.1
nodes.rationale: Fonts may be bundled with software as long as each copy carries the copyright notice and license and the font is not sold by itself.

nodes.label: captura test tag (screenshot tests)
nodes.rationale: Screenshot tests write PNGs into capturas/ for visual inspection, not verification, so they are skipped by default and run manually via test/captura_test.dart --tags captura --run-skipped.

nodes.label: Demo login and unencrypted SQLite
nodes.rationale: Access remains demo-only and SQLite unencrypted; production auth and Firebase need additional security and integration work.

nodes.label: Shared SQLite open across concurrent requests
nodes.norm_label: shared sqlite open across concurrent requests

nodes.label: CSV formula-injection protection
nodes.rationale: Texts that could be interpreted as spreadsheet formulas are protected and line breaks are escaped.

nodes.label: Opening date (apertura) boundary
nodes.rationale: New future movements and those before the configured opening are rejected; summary and charts exclude them, while history keeps old records so they can be reviewed.

nodes.label: Amounts stored as integer cents
nodes.rationale: Max two decimals; invalid, excessive and zero-cent movements are rejected to avoid silent money errors.

nodes.label: Version-conditional backup marking
nodes.rationale: Marking a backup only affects the version that was sent, never a later edit.

nodes.label: Database migration v1 to v2
nodes.rationale: Deterministic order when creation dates tie; records are never deleted and data already migrated to v2 is not renumbered automatically.

nodes.label: Transactional operation/receipt numbering
nodes.rationale: Numbers are assigned in the same SQLite transaction that saves the movement; numbering is local only, not multi-device.

nodes.label: Initial balances validation
nodes.rationale: Invalid initial balances are no longer silently converted to zero.

nodes.label: path_provider_android 2.2.23 override
nodes.rationale: Since 2.3.0 path_provider_android uses JNI, forcing native compilation that requires the Android NDK (over 1 GB download); 2.2.x does the same over the classic channel. Removable once the NDK is installed.

nodes.label: ic_launcher_foreground.png (xxxhdpi, 432x432)
nodes.description: Adaptive launcher icon foreground layer at xxxhdpi (4x, 432x432 px): flat orange (#F26A1B-ish) half-disc sitting on a flat baseline, with two dark-brown dot eyes and a curved smile, centered on a transparent background.

nodes.label: Adaptive Icon Foreground Layer (ic_launcher_foreground)
nodes.rationale: Android adaptive icons (API 26+) split the launcher icon into a background and a foreground layer on a 108dp canvas; the foreground is exported once per density bucket (mdpi 108px, hdpi 162px, xhdpi 216px, xxhdpi 324px, xxxhdpi 432px) so the launcher picks a crisp bitmap for the device. The artwork is kept small and centered (roughly the middle half of the canvas) so it stays inside the ~66dp safe zone and is not clipped by circle/squircle masks or parallax/pulse animations.

nodes.label: Orange Smiling Semicircle Mascot (app brand mark)
nodes.norm_label: orange smiling semicircle mascot (app brand mark)
nodes.rationale: Flat, friendly mascot (orange half-sun/half-coin shape with a smile) used as the Libro-caja app's launcher glyph; minimal shapes and a single saturated hue keep it legible at 48dp and consistent across all density exports.

nodes.label: Libro-caja App Launcher Icon (smiling orange semicircle mascot)
nodes.norm_label: libro-caja app launcher icon (smiling orange semicircle mascot)
nodes.rationale: Flat, friendly mascot: a vivid orange half-circle (rising-sun / peeking character) with two dark dot eyes and a small smile, anchored to the bottom edge of a cream/off-white rounded-square tile. Warm, playful branding makes a cash-book (libro caja) finance app feel approachable rather than clinical; the single design is rasterized at five Android densities so it stays crisp on every launcher.

nodes.label: Android Mipmap Density Buckets (mdpi/hdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi)
nodes.rationale: Android selects a launcher bitmap from res/mipmap-<density>/ at runtime (1x/1.5x/2x/3x/4x of a 48dp baseline); shipping one ic_launcher per bucket avoids blurry upscaling and wasted downscaling on device home screens.
